note: Read raw because the sampler that produced beats.jsonl for this beat was still reading the guard verdict off phases[].checkpoint_write. Corrected in the same window; from the 00:15Z beat onward beats.jsonl carries `banked` itself.
what_it_means: banked == {} on a `complete` terminal is EXPECTED and is NOT the guard declining to fire. precompute_calibration only calls build_checkpoint() when the terminal is not `complete` — a completing beat calls clear_main_checkpoint() instead — so the carry guard was never consulted on this beat and cannot have been.
